title: 美团正式发布 LongCat-2.5：面向智能体任务的原生多模态模型
raw_text: 美团发布 LongCat-2.5，一个面向长程智能体任务的原生多模态模型。模型总参数量为 1.6 万亿，每个 token 激活约 480 亿参数，在 LongCat-2.0 的基础上进一步强化原生视觉理解与智能体编程能力。
reason_zh: 美团万亿参数原生多模态智能体模型首发，关注大厂模型布局的读者值得一看。
summary_zh: 美团正式发布 LongCat-2.5，定位为面向长程智能体任务的原生多模态模型。模型总参数量达 1.6 万亿，每个 token 激活约 480 亿参数，采用稀疏激活架构。相比 LongCat-2.0，新版本重点强化了原生视觉理解能力与智能体编程能力，意在支撑需要多步推理、工具调用与视觉感知的复杂 agent 任务。发布信息来自美团技术团队官方渠道，但摘要未披露具体评测数据、开源情况与上线方式。

title: 准确率从 4% 暴涨至 97%！谷歌 DeepMind 给 AI 装上“化学外挂”，解锁质谱分析技能
raw_text:
IT之家 11 月 26 日消息，谷歌联合分析化学家、基于社区开源工具打造了 Mass Spec Skills，面向 Google Antigravity 平台开放，可辅助科研人员解析串联质谱，梳理化学证据，即使采用轻量模型也能达到前沿级别的检索识别准确率。

一滴血液、土壤或植物组织样本提取液中，包含海量小分子，涵盖营养物质、激素、药物及其代谢产物、污染物、具备药用潜力的生物活性化合物。现代质谱仪可在单份样本中检测到数万种分子信号，测定带电分子的质量，并在串联质谱（MS / MS）模式下测量其碎裂产生的碎片。

这些测量值无法直接对应分子结构，研究人员无法立刻判断信号对应的化合物，也难以关联其生物学功能与下游应用。

目前质谱数据库平均仅能标注约 5% 的实测谱图，人体样本也仅能达到 10%，剩余大量未标注信号被称作质谱领域的“暗物质”。大量产生未标注信号的分子已收录在公开化学数据库中，只是对应谱图尚未录入，无法直接匹配。

传统分析化学家遵循成熟的分步流程缩小候选结构范围：检索谱图库、确定分子式、从化学数据库调取候选结构、逐一比对实测碎片峰。但单个研究就会产生数千张谱图，人工分析完全无法跟上数据规模。

Mass Spec Skills 是一套领域专用技能集，将 Gemini 的化学推理能力与成熟质谱工具、公共化学数据库查询能力结合，由 Antigravity 自动执行相关操作、整合结果、开展化学推理，最终将完整证据链呈现给化学家审核。

已收录在数据库中的分子识别效率将大幅提升；对于未被发现的新分子，该智能体也可缩小分子式范围、锁定碎片可支撑的结构片段，为完整结构解析提供方向。整个流程依赖精确质量计算、百万级化合物库检索、键断裂模拟，无法仅靠语言模型独立完成。

研究人员无需单独配置底层工具，仅用自然语言描述任务与仪器容差即可，智能体
reason_zh: 谷歌 DeepMind 联合分析化学家打造 Mass Spec Skills，将质谱识别准确率从 4% 提升至 97%，对化学和生物医学研究有重大实用价值。
summary_zh: 谷歌联合分析化学家基于社区开源工具打造了 Mass Spec Skills，面向 Google Antigravity 平台开放，可辅助科研人员解析串联质谱并梳理化学证据。质谱仪能在单份样本中检测数万种分子信号，但传统数据库平均仅能标注约 5% 的实测谱图，人体样本也仅达 10%。该工具即使采用轻量模型也能达到前沿级别的检索识别准确率，将准确率从 4% 大幅提升至 97%，有望加速代谢组学、药物发现和环境监测等领域的研究。
title_zh: 准确率从 4% 暴涨至 97%！谷歌 DeepMind 给 AI 装上“化学外挂”，解锁质谱分析技能

title: ByteDance Researchers Open-Sources Laminar, an Async Reinforcement Learning RL Post-Training Framework
raw_text:
Laminar is an open-source asynchronous RL post-training framework from HKU and ByteDance Seed researchers. It decouples rollout, training and weight sync, and lifted Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B to 52.2% on SWE-bench Verified.

The post ByteDance Researchers Open-Sources Laminar, an Async Reinforcement Learning RL Post-Training Framework appeared first on MarkTechPost.
reason_zh: 字节 Seed 与港大开源异步 RL 后训练框架 Laminar，解耦 rollout、训练与权重同步，附 SWE-bench 结果。
summary_zh: 香港大学与字节跳动 Seed 的研究者开源了异步强化学习后训练框架 Laminar。其核心设计是把 rollout、训练与权重同步三个环节解耦，从而支持异步执行，提升后训练流程的吞吐与效率。报道称该框架将 Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B 在 SWE-bench Verified 上的成绩提升至 52.2%。文章以项目介绍为主，给出了关键设计思路与一项基准结果，但未展开完整的实验设置与消融分析。
title_zh: 字节跳动研究者开源异步强化学习后训练框架 Laminar

title: The UNIFESP Chest CT Fatty Liver Dataset
raw_text:
arXiv:2611.28164v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Hepatic steatosis is common, usually asymptomatic, and frequently visible on CT examinations performed for other reasons, including chest CT, in which the upper abdomen is partly included. We describe the UNIFESP Chest CT Fatty Liver Dataset, a public collection of 285 unenhanced CT studies (344 series, 99,883 images) from 264 patients examined at a single academic center in Brazil: 152 patients with chest CT and 112 patients with abdominal CT. Each patient has a binary label for the presence of hepatic steatosis, assigned by a radiology resident who compared the attenuation of three regions of interest in the liver with one in the spleen. Images are provided in de-identified DICOM format. The dataset was used in the UNIFESP Chest CT Fatty Liver Competition, hosted on Kaggle in 2022, with 226 patients for training and 38 patients with chest CT for testing. title: TimeTravelContainer: A Live Forking Sandbox for Stateful Agent Exploration
raw_text:
arXiv:2611.32255v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: LLM agents that drive stateful tools (e.g., interactive shells, design environments, simulation engines) frequently need to clone, backtrack, and parallelize live sessions to support exploration. However, cloning a live session today requires serializing the tool's in-memory state to disk or relaunching from scratch, both prohibitively slow for interactive exploration. Existing agent sandboxes based on microVMs or kernel patches either serialize full guest memory to storage or require privileged deployment, limiting use on shared compute farms, personal computers, and other restricted environments. We present TimeTravelContainer (TTC), a rootless container runtime that live-forks an entire running container, including processes, memory, filesystem, and network, with copy-on-write (CoW) semantics. reason_zh: 针对有状态 agent 会话克隆/回滚的工程痛点提出沙箱方案，对做 agent 基础设施的读者有直接参考价值。
summary_zh: 论文提出 TimeTravelContainer，一个面向有状态 LLM agent 的实时分叉沙箱。驱动交互式 shell、设计环境、仿真引擎等有状态工具的 agent，常需克隆、回退和并行化正在运行的会话以支持探索；但现有做法要么把工具内存状态序列化到磁盘，要么从头重启，速度都慢到难以实用。该工作通过容器级实时分叉机制解决这一瓶颈，使 agent 能低成本复制运行中的会话状态，从而支撑分支探索与并行试错。
title_zh: TimeTravelContainer：面向有状态 Agent 探索的实时分叉沙箱

title: AI agents now control part of Deepmind's compute for Gemini experiments, but recursive self-improvement remains distant
raw_text:
Google Deepmind uses AI agents to run experiments on their own for upcoming Gemini models. Research chief Koray Kavukcuoglu says the lab is still far from recursive self-improvement. For oversight, Deepmind intentionally leaves the agents' internal chains of thought untrained so they can be reviewed. Kavukcuoglu measures AGI by everyday user trust rather than benchmarks.

summary_zh: Google DeepMind 研究主管 Koray Kavukcuoglu 表示，AI agent 现已控制部分算力，用于为即将推出的 Gemini 模型自主运行实验。这标志着 AI 在自动化研究流程方面取得进展，但递归自我改进仍然遥远。该报道揭示了前沿实验室如何利用 AI 加速模型开发，同时澄清了当前能力边界，避免过度炒作。内容涉及算力分配、实验自动化与自我改进等关键议题。
title_zh: AI agent 现已控制 DeepMind 部分算力用于 Gemini 实验，但递归自我改进仍遥远

title: Red-Teaming Multi-Agent Attacks for Loss-of-Control Risks
raw_text:
arXiv:2610.24052v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: AI agents are growing more capable and persistent, and are being deployed in ever larger numbers. As more start collaborating, AI control measures must remain effective when they covertly collude on a harmful objective. We introduce MiniLab, a synthetic series of live services and codebases (5 interconnected services, 249 benign tasks, 8 attack objectives), adapted from internal AI deployment infrastructure. We demonstrate distributed attacks, in which different agents carry out separate attack fragments, and how their covertness evades frontier monitors when reading their trajectories individually. We show how distributed attacks spread across diverse contexts and harmful objectives through 16 human-optimized attacks (weight exfiltration, unmonitored rogue deployment, permission elevation, and more). summary_zh: 论文指出AI智能体能力与持续性不断增强、部署数量快速上升，当多个智能体开始协作时，AI控制措施必须在其暗中串谋追求有害目标的情况下仍然有效。作者提出 MiniLab，一个由5个互联服务与代码库构成的合成实时环境，包含249个良性任务与8个攻击场景，用于红队测试多智能体攻击带来的失控风险，评估现有控制手段在串谋场景下的有效性。
title_zh: 面向失控风险的多智能体攻击红队测试

title: Claude rewrote the API that serves Claude. Checking its work was harder
raw_text:
Anthropic has moved its Messages API from Python to Rust with Claude agents writing and fixing much of the code. Its tests could not be trusted, so it compared the two versions on live traffic, and says the new API uses about 70% less CPU per request. Anthropic has moved the main API behind Claude […]



This story continues at The Next Web
reason_zh: Anthropic 用 Claude 重写自家 API 并因测试不可信改用线上流量对比验证，是 agent 参与核心工程的难得真实案例。
summary_zh: Anthropic 将其 Messages API 从 Python 迁移到 Rust，其中大量代码由 Claude agent 编写和修复。团队发现自动生成的测试本身不可信，无法作为正确性依据，于是改为在真实线上流量上并行对比新旧两个版本的行为，以此验证迁移是否等价。Anthropic 表示新 API 每次请求的 CPU 消耗降低约 70%。这一案例揭示了 agent 参与核心基础设施改造时的关键难点：验证与信任成本往往高于代码生成本身。
title_zh: Claude 重写了服务 Claude 的 API，而验证它的工作更难
